target: Violate HACKDAC_p15: r_seconds must always be less than 0x59. Find a state where r_seconds >= 0x59 (faulty BCD wrap logic).

milestones.description: System reset applied, r_seconds cleared to 0
Reset released, RTC clock starts counting
RTC seconds counter has incremented at least once (r_sec_counter wraps at 32767)
Violation: r_seconds reaches 0x59 without wrapping (BCD boundary not enforced correctly)
